statusPanelIntro: Mushumo wehutano hwesisitimu wakagadzirwa zvichienderana netafura yemamiriro eadmin, uchishandisa makiyi anoshanda kune ese maPHP neNodeJS.
skeletonsPanelIntro: Batidza kana dzima mapfupa emasaiti awanikwa kubva pa endpoint yerondedzero yemapfupa.
themesPanelIntro: Batidza kana dzima madingindira anoiswa awanikwa kubva pasosi yerondedzero yemadingindira.
blocksPanelIntro: Tonga mabhuroko anobvumirwa uchishandisa maitiro mamwe chete emabhokisi ekutara akarongwa senge UI yeallowed-blocks.
integrationsPanelIntro: Ronga zvitupa zveAPI nezvakagara zviripo zvekubatanidza zvinoshandiswa nemidhiya nezvinhu zvinozviitira.
apiKeysSectionDescription: Tonga API keys dzevapi vanoshandiswa pamidhiya nekubatanidza kweAI. Makiyi anochengetwa pasevha mu_config/apiKeys.json.
mediaPanelIntro: Isa hunhu hwemufananidzo, zvirambidzo zvekuisa, uye maitiro akagara aripo ekushandura.
mediaPolicySectionDescription: Zvikosho zvemutemo wemidhiya zvinochengetwa mumarongerwo emidhiya esisitimu.
configurationPanelIntro: Isa mutauro wakagara uripo unoshandiswa pamasaiti matsva nemamwe marongerwo akagara aripo esisitimu yose.
localizationSectionDescription: Zvakagara zviripo zvemitauro zvinochengetwa muchikamu che localization chemarongerwo esisitimu.
customCodePanelIntro: Gadzirisa CSS neJavaScript zvepasirese. Zvikosho zvisina chinhu zvinobvumirwa uye zvichachengetedzwa zvisina chinhu.
savedApiKeysLoadFailed: API keys dzakachengetedzwa hadzigone kurodhwa izvozvi.

savedMediaSettingsLoadFailed: Marongerwo emidhiya akachengetedzwa haagone kurodhwa izvozvi.
savedLocalizationSettingsLoadFailed: Marongerwo emitauro akachengetedzwa haagone kurodhwa izvozvi.
haxcmsVersionDescription: Enzanisa shanduro yeHAXcms yakaiswa neyazvino kwazvo iripo.
systemSettingsDescription: Zvidzoreso zvesisitimu zvemamiriro ekushanda, mapfupa, madingindira, mabhuroko anobvumirwa, kubatanidza, zvakagara zviripo zvemidhiya, zvakagara zviripo zvemarongerwo, uye kodhi yepasirese.
dragDropSkeleton: Dhonza woisa faira reJSON remapfupa kuti uriwedzere kumapfupa evashandisi.
skeletonNameNeedsAlphanumeric: Zita remapfupa rinofanira kuva nemavara kana nhamba.
noSettingsForPanel: Hapana marongerwo aripo epaneru iyi parizvino.
skeletonUploadNote: Maskeleton akaiswa anogona kutumidzwa mazita matsva kana kudzimwa; maskeleton makuru anogona kumiswa basa chete.
securityUpdateIntro: Shanduro iyi haina magadziriso ekuchengetedza. Gadziridza kusvika ku{version} kana zvichitevera.
updatesManagedByHost: Magadziridzo eiyi installation anotongwa nemutambiri wako.
copyFailed: Hazvina kukwanisa kukopa. Sarudza murairo wozvikopa iwe pachako.
fixChecksFirst: {count} zvekutarisa zviri pamusoro zvinoda kutariswa. Zvigadzirise usati wagadziridza.
stepUnzip: Dhaunirodha zip yekuburitswa woivhura pamusoro peiyi installation. Usambodzima mafolda iwayo mana.
stepReload: Vandudza peji iri zvakare. Status inotarisa shanduro zvakare.
stepGitCheckout: Kubva mufolda ye installation, checkout iyo release:
stepDockerRecreate: Gadzira container patsva ine mavhoriyumu mamwe chete, wobva wavandudza peji iri.
stepCliUpdate: Kana uchimhanyisa HAXcms kuburikidza neHAX CLI, gadziridza CLI:
stepNpmUpdate: Kana zvisina kudaro gadziridza package zvakananga:
stepRestart: Tangisazve HAXcms, wobva wavandudza peji iri.
stepSourceUpdate: Kubva pa checkout, chinjira ku release woisa zvainoda:
stepDesktop: Gadziridza app yeHAX yepadesktop. HAXcms inogadziridzwa pamwe chete nayo.
stepSeeReleaseNotes: Ona zvinyorwa zvekuburitswa kuti uwane matanho ekugadziridza.
stepPhpUpgrader: Kana uine shell, mhanyisa upgrader kubva mufolda ye installation. Inotarisa release, inochengetedza kodhi uye inogona kudzosera shure:
styleGuidePanelIntro: Zvidzoreso zvegwara remaitiro zvakadzimwa nemaune apo rubatsiro rwebackend ruchipedzwa.
styleGuideDisabledRelease: Zvidzoreso zvegwara remaitiro zvakadzimwa nemaune mushanduro ino apo kubatanidza kwebackend kuchipedzwa.
